title: Strata Memory Record
description: One long-term memory (design/45-Long-Term-Memory.md): a record an application stores with an embedding and finds again by similarity, written and read through IMemoryStore / MemoryStore. Identified by (namespace, tenant, id). The stores keep their own columns (schema/fixtures/memory/); this is the record's JSON form, for fixtures and the CLI.

namespace.description: The kind of memory (incidents, runbooks, facts). A search never crosses one. At most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

tenant.description: Whose memory it is; empty when the application has none. A search reads one tenant only. At most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

id.description: Unique within (namespace, tenant). At most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

model.description: What made the vector, as free text compared exactly (the helper writes <provider>/<model>). Vectors of different models are never compared.

vector.description: As many finite numbers as the store's dimensions, not all zero. Stored as float32.

text.description: The text the vector was made from, kept so a namespace can be embedded again by another model. Never searched.

metadata.description: String pairs a search and a listing can filter on by equality. Keys are non-empty, at most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

created_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, whole seconds, from the store's clock when the record was first written. Kept by a replacing upsert.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, whole seconds, from the store's clock at the latest upsert. What retention purges by.
